Things I think about for my overall portfolio is having both a wealth creation aspect, and a wealth preservation aspect.  having a set target for overall volatility.  Having orthogonal and convex bets. Smoothing the path of returns which has been a god send.  Having my trading fees be zero Trying to use limit orders vs crossing the spread as often as possible. using tax aware strategies. Whether that be something like AQR to offset ordinary income, or PPLI to have tax free growth where you can wrap your assets inside for high turnover strategies allowing you to compound tax free. These all make a complete book and allow for max growth.

Qube is another place I like. They I believe have averaged closer to 30% returns per year, although a much shorter history. 2018-current. And annualized vol is around 12-16%. With little to no correlation to the market at essentially .2 beta. These are just some places I like personally. bc I have target vol and beta in mind for this. 

Statar is another great one, nat gas at around 20% per year. Again, completely independent of the market. 

These are more for non-correlated returns, orthogonal bets that can move and provide independent returns from the market that typically you can't reproduce yourself. So these buckets for investments have different goals then you're trading goals as true diversifiers. Where as having something that is correlated just ends up being the same bet you are already making in your trades for example. 

Also adding bets that have good convexity in stress events, but for the most part do nothing most the year helps although that is very small.
